sources.finding: The site offers macOS12+ downloads, describes local Claude Code/Codex sessions and parallel stories with Git worktrees, and puts Windows, Linux and phone platforms on waitlists.

sources.title: Installation and prerequisites
sources.locator: System requirements; coding-agent/provider setup; GitHub CLI
sources.finding: Documents macOS12+, Git and at least one configured coding CLI or API key. GitHub CLI is optional for repository import and PR workflows.

sources.title: Actual coding harness and API routes
sources.locator: Claude Code; Codex; API keys; per-chat provider selection
sources.finding: The adapter documentation names installed Claude Code and Codex CLI with existing subscriptions, plus separate Anthropic/OpenAI API-key modes. Provider model names do not create additional coding-harness integrations.

sources.title: Story Git workflow
sources.locator: Story branches; worktrees; commits; pull requests
sources.finding: Documents local story branches, parallel worktrees, story-associated commits and opening PRs. It does not expose actual displayed diff content in the retrieved page.

sources.title: Story workspace intake
sources.locator: Why the spec editor matters; Writing specs in MDX; What this unlocks for AI
sources.finding: Describes the story specification editor, MDX content, requirements and acceptance criteria used as context for AI execution.

sources.title: Documented sub-agent concept
sources.finding: Describes a parent assigning specialized work in parallel, but does not establish the product-owned launch mechanism, activation or distinction from native provider subagents in the retrieved page.

sources.title: Current desktop license prices
sources.locator: Free; Solo; Team; Terms and answers
sources.finding: Lists Free $0 forever for one project, Solo $20/month or $169 lifetime, and Team $20/seat/month with a three-seat minimum. Earlier legacy deals are distinguished from current offers.

sources.title: Desktop software license and currency
sources.locator: Effective May22,2026; license grant; ownership; pricing
sources.finding: Grants a limited proprietary application license, retains Lekiks intellectual-property ownership, restricts redistribution and states prices in USD excluding tax.

sources.title: Desktop usage analytics disclosure and control
sources.locator: Last updated October9,2026; Desktop app usage analytics; optional account; iOS section
sources.finding: Discloses background PostHog product events with install identifier/device metadata and download-to-install attribution, and says Settings → About → Share anonymous usage data stops further analytics/attribution. The separate iOS policy is not proof of current phone shipment.

sources.title: Published-versus-preview changelog
sources.locator: Latest published v1.5.201; Unreleased preview September21,2026
sources.finding: The page still calls September1 build1.5.201 latest and labels the September21 delivery/forge/team/diagnostics entries as integration-testing preview with no version/date. Later release metadata conflicts with its latest-published label; it does not resolve which preview features shipped.

sources.title: Distribution-repository metadata
sources.finding: The endpoint resolves to AIDEN-LABS-CORP/aiden-releases, described as release binaries; archived:false and fork:false apply only to that distribution repository, not public application-source availability.

sources.title: Desktop release metadata
sources.locator: Release rows ordered by published_at; tag_name, assets, prerelease
sources.finding: The newest returned non-prerelease is v1.5.233 published2026-10-14T20:26:35Z, with arm64/Intel Mac zip/dmg assets and update metadata. The release body is null; no preview feature parity is inferred.

sources.title: Continuing free access and no trial
sources.locator: Pricing / Available plans; paragraph beginning No trial
sources.finding: The homepage explicitly says there is no trial, lists a continuing Free application plan, and separates the application price from the user’s Claude Code or Codex subscription.
